messages:
Lee: Heads-up — planning a config-only roll during the 18:00 UTC change window. This touches routing weights + batching window. Minimal change but please watch p95, error-rate, and dropped reqs. Rolling canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% over ~10m. Can someone ack?

Lee: config diff:
```json
{
  "routing_policy": "cost_aware",
  "tenant_pin": { "critical_tenants": ["payments", "search"] },
  "batch_window_ms": 8,
  "max_batch_tokens": 4096
}
```

Emma: ack. I'll watch p95 + traces and post if anything odd. :eyes:

Jon: oncall here, will shadow logs and kvcache stats. Ping me if rollback needed.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary start for c-2026-0423-01 -> svc-inference-prod. Canary stage: 5% for 5m. Link: https://deploys.redwood/c-2026-0423-01

deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary metrics (5m): p50 +1ms, p95 +9%, errors +0.03pp (baseline 0.02%). CPU and GPU util stable. KV cache hit rate down ~3% on a subset of pods.

Priya: I see the same in traces — some longer tail on models with >2k tokens. The batch_window bump to 8ms seems to increase KV churn on small sequences.

Lee: Hmm. Not great for our long-context customers. Can we pin routing for the two critical tenants to previous weights while we investigate?

Emma: We can pin critical tenants back to old routing in config without full rollback — do we want that as a quick mitigation?

Jon: Given p95 jump, I'd prefer full rollback for safety. Pinning helps but leaves the rest of traffic degraded. My call: rollback.

Lee: Agreed — rollback. We'll revisit batch_window change and run an A/B on a small tenant set.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: initiating rollback of c-2026-0423-01. Canary traffic reverted. Rollback complete at ts 1765012380.

Emma: Thanks team. I'll open a follow-up cadence: try batch_window_ms=6 and run targeted kvpressure tests on long-context workloads before reattempting.

Priya: +1. I captured traces and a small repro; linking: https://observability.redwood/trace/abcd1234

Lee: Good catch everyone. We'll target the next quiet window (Sunday 02:00 UTC) after the test. :thumbsup:
